skills.name: Android build cycle
skills.description: Build and verify an Android project correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read build.gradle.kts and gradle.properties first.
2. Build with android.build (or gradle.exec assembleDebug).
3. Read the failure precisely; fix the FIRST error, not the last.
4. Rebuild to confirm; summarize what fixed it.

skills.name: Manifest audit
skills.description: Review permissions and components in the manifest.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read AndroidManifest.xml.
2. List declared permissions and reason about each: needed or leftover?
3. Check exported flags on activities, services and receivers.
4. Propose minimal changes with file.patch; rebuild with android.build.

skills.name: Room migration authoring
skills.description: Write safe Room schema migrations.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the entities and current DB version.
2. For new columns use ALTER TABLE with defaults; for new tables use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS.
3. Write the Migration object; register it in the builder.
4. Bump version; prove with gradle.exec and explain row preservation.

skills.name: Android lifecycle safety
skills.description: Avoid leaks and crashes across lifecycle events.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for context captures in long-lived objects (singletons, viewmodels, services).
2. Replace Activity contexts with applicationContext where safe.
3. Move coroutine work into viewModelScope or lifecycleScope.
4. Verify with gradle.exec; reason about rotation and process death in the summary.

skills.name: Runtime permissions flow
skills.description: Request and check Android permissions correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the manifest permission list.
2. Map each dangerous permission to its runtime request path.
3. Implement check-then-request with graceful denial handling.
4. Verify with android.build; describe the user flow.

skills.name: Android storage strategy
skills.description: Pick the right storage API for the job.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Classify the data: app-private, shared media, or documents.
2. App-private: filesDir. Shared media: MediaStore. User docs: SAF.
3. Check external storage manager state for all-files-access paths.
4. Implement with file.write and file.read against the chosen root; test on device.

skills.name: APK decode and inspect
skills.description: Break down an APK for analysis.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm the APK path; run re.apk.manifest for identity and permissions.
2. re.apktool.decode into a workspace folder.
3. Inspect smali and resources with file.search.
4. Summarize: package, version, min and target SDK, notable components.

skills.name: APK patch pipeline
skills.description: Decode, patch smali, rebuild, sign, install.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apktool.decode the target APK.
2. Patch smali with file.read and file.patch; keep changes minimal and targeted.
3. re.apktool.build to rebuild; re.apk.sign to debug-sign.
4. re.apk.install (root) or adb install; verify launch and behavior.

skills.name: APK signing
skills.description: Debug-sign rebuilt APKs for installation.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Ensure the APK is built (re.apktool.build output).
2. re.apk.sign with the debug keystore.
3. Verify signature info in the tool output.
4. Install with re.apk.install and confirm it launches.

skills.name: Smali reading and editing
skills.description: Read and patch smali bytecode safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate the class of interest with file.search in the decoded tree.
2. Read registers and invoke patterns carefully; smali is unforgiving.
3. Patch minimal instructions; keep register counts valid.
4. Rebuild with re.apktool.build to catch assembly errors early.

skills.name: APK identity checks
skills.description: Compare package names, versions and signatures.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest on both APKs to compare package and versionName.
2. Note signature differences (debug vs release).
3. Explain installation implications (signature mismatch blocks updates).
4. Recommend the correct install path (uninstall first or matching signature).

skills.name: Activity flow analysis
skills.description: Map an app navigation graph statically.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest to list activities and intent filters.
2. file.search smali for startActivity and forResult calls.
3. Draw the navigation edges in text form.
4. Flag exported entries and deep links as entry surface.

skills.name: Android resource work
skills.description: Add and wire resources without breaking the build.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the res folders to see existing conventions.
2. Add strings, colors and drawables in the right value folders.
3. Reference them correctly in code and layouts.
4. Build with android.build; fix any AAPT errors at the cited lines.

skills.name: Android services review
skills.description: Audit background services and their lifecycles.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest or file.read to list declared services.
2. file.search for startService, stopService and startForeground usage.
3. Verify foreground services show notifications as required.
4. Flag services started at boot or on schedule for review.

skills.name: Broadcast receiver audit
skills.description: Map receiver exposure and intent handling.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List receivers from the manifest (file.read or re.apk.manifest).
2. Note exported receivers and permissions guarding them.
3. file.search smali for the onReceive handling paths.
4. Report: what can external apps trigger?

skills.name: Deep link testing
skills.description: Enumerate and test deep link handlers.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract scheme and host pairs from the manifest.
2. Fire test intents with process.exec am start commands.
3. Observe the resulting activity via androidreadscreen.
4. Report which links resolve and any crashes.

skills.name: Deploy to device
skills.description: Get a build onto a device and verify it.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Build with android.build or gradle.exec assembleDebug.
2. Install via re.apk.install (root) or adb install through process.exec.
3. Launch with androidopenapp or an am start command.
4. Verify startup with androidreadscreen and logcat checks.

skills.name: Logcat crash triage
skills.description: Turn a crash log into a fix.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture logcat via process.exec; filter to the app and crash buffer.
2. Extract the exception type, message and deepest app frame.
3. file.read that frame; form one hypothesis.
4. Patch with file.patch; rebuild with android.build; re-run to verify.

skills.name: Gradle dependency hygiene
skills.description: Resolve version conflicts and missing artifacts.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read build.gradle.kts (app and project level).
2. Identify conflicting versions of the same group.
3. Align to the newest needed; patch the build files.
4. Run gradle.exec; read resolution errors carefully (they name the conflict).

skills.name: R8 and ProGuard rules
skills.description: Fix release-build crashes caused by shrinking.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect the missing-class or NPE stack from the release run.
2. Add targeted keep rules for affected classes (reflection, serialization, JNI).
3. Rebuild release with gradle.exec.
4. Verify the original crash path again; avoid blanket keep rules.

skills.name: Build variants and flavors
skills.description: Configure product flavors correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the flavors block in build.gradle.kts.
2. Map each flavor to its source set and config differences.
3. Patch misconfigurations; keep applicationId suffixes correct.
4. Build the specific variant with gradle.exec and verify.

skills.name: App UI automation on device
skills.description: Drive an installed app with accessibility tools.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidopenapp the target; androidreadscreen to see state.
2. Plan the tap sequence; prefer androidclickelement over raw coordinates.
3. Execute steps; verify each with a fresh read.
4. Use androidpressback to unwind when lost; report final state.

skills.name: Screenshot verification loop
skills.description: Prove UI changes with captured evidence.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android_screenshot before the change; note the state.
2. Apply the change (build plus install or in-app action).
3. android_screenshot after; compare visually.
4. Report both states with timestamps and describe the delta.

skills.name: Reliable text entry on device
skills.description: Type text into apps without losing focus.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen to find the field; androidclickelement or android_tap to focus it.
2. Verify focus state before typing.
3. androidtypetext the content in one call.
4. androidreadscreen to confirm the text landed; correct with backspaces if needed.

skills.name: System settings navigation
skills.description: Guide an app to its permission screens.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android.app_settings opens the app details page.
2. androidreadscreen; androidclickelement on Permissions or Storage.
3. Toggle the requested switch; verify with a fresh read.
4. Return with androidpressback; summarize what changed.

skills.name: SMS dispatch flow
skills.description: Send messages via the SMS tool with confirmation.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm recipient number and message content with the user.
2. android.sms.send with exact values; no creative editing of content.
3. Verify the tool result reports success.
4. Note that delivery confirmation is not available; do not claim it.

skills.name: Installed app inventory
skills.description: Audit what is installed on the device.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. system.app_list to enumerate packages.
2. Group by category (system, user, debug).
3. Note version and installer for the target via dumpsys if needed.
4. Present a compact table; flag anything suspicious.

skills.name: Process monitoring
skills.description: Watch device processes for a target app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. system.process_list; find the target pid.
2. Track pid changes over time (restarts) with repeated calls.
3. Correlate restarts with logcat events.
4. Summarize stability: crashes, restarts, memory pressure.

skills.name: Stuck process recovery
skills.description: Kill and restart a misbehaving app safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm the target process with system.process_list.
2. system.process_kill with user awareness (data loss warning).
3. Relaunch with androidopenapp.
4. Verify recovery with androidreadscreen and fresh logcat.

skills.name: ADB via process.exec
skills.description: Use adb commands from the agent runtime.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec adb devices to confirm connectivity.
2. Use adb shell commands for targeted diagnostics (dumpsys, settings, pm).
3. Prefer specific commands over broad dumps; cap output.
4. Summarize findings with the exact commands used.

skills.name: dumpsys diagnostics
skills.description: Read battery, memory and package state.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec dumpsys with the specific service (battery, meminfo, package).
2. Parse only the relevant sections.
3. Compare against expectations (memory before/after an action).
4. Report numbers in a compact table.

skills.name: Gradle cache recovery
skills.description: Fix builds broken by stale caches.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture the exact gradle.exec failure.
2. Identify cache-related errors (corrupt archives, unresolved snapshots).
3. Clean the specific task or caches via process.exec.
4. Rebuild; if still failing, escalate with full output.

skills.name: NDK native build basics
skills.description: Build native components for Android.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read CMakeLists or Android.mk and the native build config.
2. Align ABI filters and toolchain settings.
3. Build with gradle.exec; native errors surface per-ABI.
4. Verify the .so landed in the APK with re.rabin2 or archive listing.

skills.name: APK size diet
skills.description: Find what bloats an APK and trim it.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Build once; list archive contents via process.exec.
2. Rank entries by size: native libs, assets, resources, dex.
3. Propose the top fixes (ABI filters, resource shrinking, asset pruning).
4. Rebuild and report the size delta.

skills.name: Instrumented UI checks
skills.description: Verify UI flows end to end on device.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Launch the app with androidopenapp.
2. Drive the flow with androidclickelement and androidtypetext; verify each step with androidreadscreen.
3. Exercise error paths deliberately (invalid input).
4. Summarize observed behavior vs expected; flag deviations.

skills.name: SDK version pinning
skills.description: Align compileSdk, targetSdk and minSdk sensibly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the sdk versions in build.gradle.kts.
2. Check library requirements (some demand newer compileSdk).
3. Patch versions minimally; do not jump SDK levels without reason.
4. Build with gradle.exec and summarize compatibility notes.

skills.name: Background job wiring
skills.description: Schedule work that survives process death.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the deferrable work and its constraints (network, charging).
2. Wire WorkManager with proper constraints and backoff.
3. Verify the enqueue path compiles with gradle.exec.
4. Explain observation strategy (logs, job state).

skills.name: Clipboard-driven automation
skills.description: Move text between apps via clipboard.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Copy source text by selecting with androidlongpress plus androidclickelement.
2. Confirm via androidreadscreen that copy succeeded.
3. Focus the destination field; paste and verify text arrived.
4. Report any truncation or formatting loss.
